$comment: 'Active CPA license (any US state)' is a US CPA with equivalents ruled out, so the UK ACA, who meets every software requirement, fails it. The strict JD: every requirement is a hard must-have, three of them resolve to taxonomy ids, and there is a fixed latest start date. Only the SaaS CPA resume passes its hard filters. The 'Senior Accountant or equivalent role at a software or SaaS company' line gives the industry.

requirements.title: Senior Accountant
must_haves: Minimum 5 years of accounting experience, including at least 2 years in a Senior Accountant or equivalent role at a software or SaaS company
Hands-on NetSuite experience as a daily user: journal imports, saved searches, multi-subsidiary consolidation
Advanced Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP or INDEX-MATCH, Power Query)
Located in the San Francisco Bay Area and able to work from our SoMa office Tuesday through Thursday; Pacific time hours
Able to start on or before Monday, November 2, 2026
nice_to_haves: Experience with ASC 606 for multi-element SaaS contracts
